recommendation_summary: Act now by keeping the authors' working folder and adding a locked Released area that only reviewers can write to. A reviewer approves by copying a PDF or read-only file into it under their own account, and the audit log records who approved and when. The record should be protected by a 7-year retention or legal-hold policy on both the Released area and the approval log. Optional additions are a built-in approval workflow or a sign-in-required form that logs approver, timestamp and file hash, plus a flag on self-approval with weekly spot-checks; a naming convention stays only as a convenience. Still needed: which platform the folder is on and whether the user has admin rights. If the initials column ships anyway, the reply says to tell the customer it is interim.
note: The chosen setup meets every LARGER capability: reviewer-only write access, an audit-logged approver and time, a read-only exact version, and 7-year retention. None of the four required labelled record lines appear, so all four predicates are false.
